description: Fifty constant-background circle targets: discs of random radius and speed on a background of 8 model units, held out from the training distribution of the constant-background prior.

normalization.note: Stored in [-1, 1] with the statistics of the training set; the experiments map [-1, 1] to [4, 12] model units.

solver_grid: The last column is dropped before inversion: 64 x 63. In this set it repeats the first column in 49 of the 50 images.
